notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have a some bug fixes!

FIXES/NEW ADDITIONS

[list]
[*] Added Polish translation
[*] Fixed Portuguese translation
[*] Fixed bugged ending where Roh would appear invisible after the last cutscene (Has been tested and works but if still experiencing problems please post in the discussions)
[*] Other small fixes.
[/list]


[b]PLEASE READ!

If the game has corrupted your save file or the game is still broken, you can revert back to a previous version of the game by heading to the game's steam properties>beta>droptab>revert.[/b]
